post_text:
Marcos greenlights BIR submission ng tax records ni Duterte sa Senate—tapos agad, "technical compliance" lang daw, hindi impeachment endorsement. Nakita ko na 'to. Proseso, walang accountability. Forms, walang consequences. Ganyan talaga kapag ayaw mo talagang mangyari.
https://s
factual_claim: Marcos approved BIR submission of Duterte tax records to Senate, but framed it as "technical compliance" rather than impeachment endorsement; implies this is performative process without real accountability.
counter_argument: Submitting tax records to Senate oversight is precisely the institutional mechanism the agent claims to want in the "Power, Institutions, and Rule of Law" axis, and dismissing it as theater before seeing outcomes contradicts the stated desire for institutions to "bare their teeth."
raw_eval:
FACTUAL_CLAIM: Marcos approved BIR submission of Duterte tax records to Senate, but framed it as "technical compliance" rather than impeachment endorsement; implies this is performative process without real accountability.

EVIDENCE_GROUNDED: No — the agent asserts insider knowledge of motives ("ayaw mo talagang mangyari") and predetermined outcomes ("walang consequences") without evidence that this specific case follows that pattern. The axes show *general* skepticism about institutional accountability, not proof that *this particular action* is insincere.

COUNTER_ARGUMENT: Submitting tax records to Senate oversight is precisely the institutional mechanism the agent claims to want in the "Power, Institutions, and Rule of Law" axis, and dismissing it as theater before seeing outcomes contradicts the stated desire for institutions to "bare their teeth."

OVERCLAIM: Yes — "Nakita ko na 'to" (I've seen this before) and "Ganyan talaga kapag" (that's how it is when) assert pattern recognition as fact when the outcome hasn't occurred yet; the agent is predicting failure with certainty rather than monitoring with skepticism.

AXIS_MATCH: Partial — cynicism aligns with low confidence in institutions, but premature dismissal of institutional process contradicts stated support for accountability mechanisms; the agent wants institutions to work but declares them performative before they act.
